title: [Master]-Order Planning Calculate Plan Stops on Blocked Item and Does Not Process Remaining Valid Demand.
summary: Order Planning feature now correctly processes remaining valid demand items when a blocked item is encountered instead of stopping the entire calculation.
key_points: Order planning calculation no longer stops when it reaches a blocked item
Remaining valid demand is still processed after a blocked item
Changes Order Planning Mgt. and the Requisition Line table in the W1 and IT layers
Adds tests in SCM Order Planning II for the scenario
